verifications.claim: Multiple reports on March 20, 2026, stated that Chuck Norris died at the age of 86.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Actor and martial arts expert Chuck Norris has passed away at the age of 86" (R1, announced March 20); "Died March 19, 2026 (aged 86)" (R2); "Chuck Norris died after sudden hospitalization in Hawaii at age 86" (R3, March 20 context)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly report his death at age 86 with announcements or coverage on March 20, 2026.

verifications.claim: The family confirmed Chuck Norris's sudden passing following a recent hospitalization in Hawaii.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "It is with heavy hearts that our family shares the sudden passing of our beloved Chuck Norris yesterday morning" ... "just one day after he was hospitalized in Hawaii" (R1); "In March 2026, Norris was hospitalized in Hawaii after experiencing a medical emergency. He died on March 19" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Family statement in R1 directly confirms sudden passing post-hospitalization in Hawaii; corroborated across sources.

verifications.claim: Reports noted that Chuck Norris had been in good spirits despite the hospitalization.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "the outlet reported that the actor was in "good spirits." " (R1); "we are told Chuck is in good spirits" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Direct mentions in reports of him being in good spirits during/after hospitalization.

verifications.claim: Reports noted that Chuck Norris was training just days before his death.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "sharing an Instagram video of himself getting in some boxing training ... on March 10" ... "on Wednesday he was training on the island" (R1); "he was training on the island … a friend of Chuck’s was on the phone with him" (R3); "training as recently as Wednesday, March 18" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly note training shortly before death (March 10 and/or 18).

verifications.claim: Chuck Norris recently celebrated his 86th birthday.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "the date of his 86th birthday" ... "March 10—the date of his 86th birthday" (R1); "Born March 10, 1940" ... died 2026 aged 86 (R2); "I’m 86 today!" video on March 10 (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm March 10, 2026, as his 86th birthday with celebratory video shared recently before death.

verifications.claim: Chuck Norris had roles in Walker, Texas Ranger, The Delta Force, and Missing in Action.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Walker, Texas Ranger" star (R1); "Walker, Texas Ranger (1993–2001)" ... "The Delta Force (1986)" ... "Missing in Action (1984)" (R2); "Delta Force" ... "Walker, Texas Ranger" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: All listed roles directly confirmed in filmography and descriptions across sources.

verifications.claim: There have been many hoax stories about Chuck Norris's death over the years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Chuck Norris has been the target of misinformation for years. In fact, a Facebook scam claimed he was dead back in 2012. He wasn’t." ... "death hoaxes" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: R7 directly documents multiple historical death hoaxes about Norris.

verifications.claim: Reports on March 20, 2026, confirmed Chuck Norris's passing
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Family announcement "on March 20" (R1); coverage dated March 20 confirming death (R3, R4, R5, R6)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple reports dated or referencing March 20 confirm his passing.
